blocks.title: Read Me First
rows: Raghav's Decisions Log
Filled by Raghav in real-time. Visible to Manisha, Saurabh, CBO, Founder. Full transparency.
What to log
Every decision Raghav makes that impacts at any level — branch, region, BM, team member, client, brand.

Specifically: hiring/firing recommendations, action plan sign-offs, spend decisions, escalations made or received, overrides of BM proposals, commitments to clients or external parties, disagreements with Manisha or Saurabh and how they were resolved.
Skip only what has zero impact at any level — routine acknowledgements, daily scheduling, agreeing with BM's existing plan as-is.
Log in real-time, not at end-of-day. Memory fades; record protects everyone.
Why this exists
Trust gets built through visibility, not assurance. Every decision Raghav takes — small, medium, big — is visible to Manisha, Saurabh, CBO, and the Founder.

This is not a surveillance tool. It is a thinking-pattern tool. Over 60-90 days, the leadership team sees how Raghav thinks: where he is solid, where he hesitates, where he over-corrects. That visibility is what allows the company to trust him on bigger decisions later.
Once entered, rows are not edited — only additions. If a decision is reversed, log the reversal as a new entry referencing the original.
